name: Roulette
description: A roulette wheel run across the plate: two rows of short ticks, the second offset by half a step.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 3); y: 12; width: 9; height: 24; fill: #000 } rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 11); y: 62; width: 9; height: 24; fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 3); y: 12; width: 9; height: 24; fill: #000 } rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 11); y: 62; width: 9; height: 24; fill: #000 }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
